articles.title: Michael Douglas Always Knew ‘One Flew Over the Cuckoo’s Nest’ Was Going to Be a Hit
articles.summary: One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest, a renowned modern classic, originated from Ken Kesey's impactful 1962 novel. This iconic story, which also saw successful stage adaptations before its acclaimed film version, continues to be celebrated for its profound narrative and enduring cultural significance, solidifying its place in artistic history worldwide.

articles.title: Media statements by the President of Russia and the Prime Minister of India
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Russian President Vladimir Putin concluded significant talks, followed by a ceremony exchanging signed documents. This high-level engagement underscores the deepening strategic partnership between India and Russia, covering various sectors. For SSB aspirants, understanding such bilateral relations is crucial for comprehending India's foreign policy and geopolitical standing.

articles.title: Marianne Faithfull – Cast Your Fate to the Wind: The Complete UK Decca Recordings 1964-1969 (2025)
articles.summary: The article details Marianne Faithfull's unusual entry into the music industry, securing a recording contract without needing to sing. This intriguing story is vividly recounted in the liner notes of her new box set, 'Cast Your Fate to the Wind: The U.K. De...', offering unique insights into her early career and the broader music industry landscape of that era.
